room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A [mooring post](mooring_post) leans into the current.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass.
detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the post. Someone has carved a fox into it.
npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry. He keeps the landing by day and goes up to the green at dusk.
narration.coil_rope.actor: You coil the wet rope around the post, slowly, the way Bram does it.
